```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-mcp-server-taskwarrior-1ee3d282"
  pattern: |
    execSync($COMMAND, { maxBuffer: $MAX_BUFFER })
  pattern-not: |
    execFileSync('task', [...$TASK_ARGS], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: $MAX_BUFFER })
  languages: ["typescript"]
  message: |
    The use of `execSync` with a command string constructed from user input can lead to command injection vulnerabilities. This is because the command string is not properly sanitized, allowing an attacker to inject malicious commands.
    
    To fix this issue, use `execFileSync` with an array of arguments instead of constructing a command string. This ensures that each argument is treated as a separate entity and prevents command injection.
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: github.com/awwaiid/mcp-server-taskwarrior/commit/1ee3d282debfa0a99afeb41d22c4b2fd5a3148f2
    category: security
    cwe: [CWE-78]
    owasp: [A1: Injection]
    references: [https://owasp.org/www-community/vulnerabilities/Command_Injection, https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html]
    technology: [typescript]
```
